meta.title: DSH Toolbox
meta.description: Searchable model picker with persistent custom groups.
status.noMatchHint: Try another term or clear the search.
status.compat: dsh-model-search detected; its search box is reused.
diagnostic.unrecognized: The model menu structure was not recognized; the native menu remains in place.
settings.title: Model groups
settings.description: Search, group, and fold models in the model picker. Configuration stays on this machine and never modifies host models.
settings.catalog.title: Model catalog
settings.catalog.empty: Open the model picker once to populate this catalog.
settings.catalog.hint: The catalog comes from the model picker; this plugin never adds, removes, or rewrites models.
settings.groups.title: Custom groups
settings.groups.empty: No groups yet. Create one to assign models.
settings.groups.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This removes only the group assignment, never a model.
settings.groups.searchPlaceholder: Search provider, model name, or ID…
settings.prefs.title: Opening behavior
settings.prefs.preserveProviderGroups: Keep provider headings in custom groups
settings.data.title: Configuration data
settings.data.restoreConfirm: Restore defaults? Current group assignments will be replaced.
settings.data.importHint: Paste JSON or choose a file. A failed validation keeps the old configuration.
settings.data.exportHint: Exports group assignments, views, and model keys only; no credentials.
settings.data.unsupportedVersion: Configuration version is newer than this plugin supports
settings.data.storageUnavailable: Local storage is unavailable; configuration lasts only for this page.
settings.missing.title: Stale model keys
settings.missing.hint: These keys no longer resolve to a model. They are preserved until you remove them.
settings.emptyCatalog: The catalog is empty. Open the model picker once and return here.
